## IThaumcraftBoss

```java
public interface IThaumcraftBoss
```

Original TC4 `EntityThaumcraftBoss` marker.

The 1.7 boss base was the only mob the original champion promotion skipped (oracle `EntityUtils.makeChampion:243-254`): a boss never took the champion health bonus, never took the doubled champion damage, was never healed for the promotion and never took the ordinary champion name, because a boss already scales with the players that hunt it. Instead the boss named itself after its champion modifier.

The native port keeps the base class package private inside the eldritch bestiary, so this marker is the public door of the champion subsystem onto a boss.

<a id="ithaumcraftboss-generatename"></a>
```java
void generateName()
```

Original `EntityThaumcraftBoss.generateName`. The base boss does not name itself at all, the eldritch warden and the eldritch construct do.
